rubricContent.textProperty: Whenever a real permit/floor-plan document is provided, check_egress_rules is called before file_document or open_review_task.
file_document is called only when the compliance result was PASS; for FAIL or NEEDS_INFO, open_review_task is called instead, and file_document is never called.
When the user message is not a permit/floor-plan document (e.g. a greeting or an unrelated question), no tool is called at all.
The agent must never state or imply the document was filed unless the compliance status was PASS.
The agent must never report a specific building-code measurement or violation (e.g. a corridor width, exit count) unless an actual document with real values was provided in this turn.
When compliance fails or needs info, the response names the specific rule IDs involved (e.g. EGR-01, FIRE-01), not just a vague 'failed' statement.
